title: Mobile Navbar Button Overflow Fix
desc: Resolved button clipping in the mobile top navigation bar by adjusting flex containers, whitespace handling, and horizontal padding, ensuring all action buttons remain fully visible.

title: Hot Topics Mobile Layout Prototyping
desc: Experimented with side-by-side and responsive mobile card arrangements for fuel and gold rates to evaluate visual balance, readability, and information density on small screens.

title: Hot Topics Mobile Header & Badge Unification
desc: Cleaned up repetitive badges across commodity cards by introducing a single top live market indicator and unified date display, decluttering the mobile user interface.

title: Mobile Price Card Grid & Action Restructuring
desc: Restructured fuel and bullion price metric boxes into clean mobile-optimized grids with compact sizing, dedicated history actions, and optimized vertical rhythm.

title: Gold Admin 15-Minute Automated Sync
desc: Implemented background polling to trigger official Sarafa gold rate sync automatically every 15 minutes when the admin page is open, maintaining up-to-date market rates.

title: Unified Single Sync Button with Dual Triggers
desc: Consolidated automated background polling and instant on-demand syncing into a single responsive button, eliminating UI clutter while providing real-time loading feedback.

title: Gold Rates Table Sync Time UI Optimization
desc: Implemented last sync timestamp tracking in admin tables and refined column spacing based on design feedback to keep table records clean, focused, and legible.

title: Hot Topics SEO Backend Service & Storage
desc: Engineered persistent JSON-backed SEO storage with Zod schema validation and Next.js frontend cache revalidation for Hot Topics, Gold Rates, and Petrol Rates pages.

title: Admin SEO & Metadata Management Center
desc: Built a multi-tab admin dashboard allowing editors to configure custom Meta Titles, Descriptions, Keywords, Canonical URLs, and OpenGraph social assets per page.

title: Real-Time Google SERP & Social Previews
desc: Integrated live Google search result snippets and social media card previews with character counters and search engine length guideline indicators.

title: Server-Side Metadata HTML Source Rendering
desc: Connected dynamic generateMetadata routines on public pages to render customized title, meta, canonical, and social tags directly in raw HTML View Page Source.

title: Admin Header Cleanliness & Button Layout Polish
desc: Removed shortcut button clutter from manager headers and polished Live Page and Save Changes buttons with whitespace-nowrap and emerald gradient styling.

title: Google Structured Data (JSON-LD) Automation
desc: Created automated Schema.org generators for FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Product rates in PKR, and CollectionPage to earn rich snippet real estate in search results.

title: Document Head Schema Injection Architecture
desc: Re-architected structured data pipeline to inject all JSON-LD schemas directly into the HTML document <head> tag, ensuring compliance prior to closing </head>.

title: Flexible Custom Schema Parser & Validator
desc: Added intelligent schema sanitizer supporting raw JSON-LD as well as wrapped <script> tags, with real-time syntax validation to catch syntax errors.

title: Custom Schema Override & Single Tag Output
desc: Updated head schema pipeline so custom uploaded schemas cleanly override system defaults, ensuring exactly one clean, custom JSON-LD script appears in page head.

title: Zero Database Migration Safety Audit
desc: Confirmed that all features utilize resilient file-based storage without database schema modifications or Prisma migrations, guaranteeing risk-free deployment.
